finalText:
I took fresh screenshots of the 4:5 post and the 16:9 cover and looked at them. Both look as intended, so all four formats are now checked: the 1:1 post, 4:5 post, 9:16 story and 16:9 cover.

On the 4:5, the headline, the when / where / who row and the seven-discipline list all sit above the footer strip. On the 16:9, the headline and **Zapiš se** button are on the left, and the event facts and disciplines on the right end above the yellow edge. The icons in the cover screenshot's bottom-right corner seem to come from the app's own tools, not from the design.

The earlier notes still apply. The date, 7. 10. 2026, is three weeks ago, so it needs changing if this is for a new or moved event. The formats use brand textures only, because the player photos aren't in this project.
